title: Local roles: a smaller read cap
lead: *Proposed.* Owner direction 2026-11-16 (relay session 8d711f67, interactive question, "Smaller reads"): a local role's Read cap is lower than 500 lines, so one session spends less of its window on one big file and greps first.
Open owner question (the implementer asks it with `adj ask` first):

- Q1 (`roles.local-read-cap`): the cap. (a) *recommended*: 150 lines, with the denial text saying to Grep for the symbol and Read 150 lines around it. (b) 250 lines. (c) 150 for the implementer, 500 for read-only roles.
findings_note: S304 trial 5 (2026-11-16, run ork-20261116-012801-28aa, S246): sessions restarted at 70k after 28-34 turns; most of the window was 500-line chunks of internal/daemon/runs.go (over 2,000 lines). The approval point caps a local Read at 500 lines (`internal/agent/claude/pretool.go:117-133`, S356).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/agent/claude/pretool.go:117-133` (the cap and its denial text)
- `internal/agent/claude/pretool_test.go`
- `internal/roles/prompts/local-system.md` (the stated limit)
- `internal/engine/brief.go` (the local tool rules, if they name 500)
- `docs/design.md`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestEvaluateLocalReadCap`: a Read with limit over the cap is denied with the new text; one at the cap is allowed.
- `TestEvaluateUnlimitedReadOfABigFile`: a Read with no limit of a file over the cap is denied.
- `TestLocalSystemPromptNamesTheCap`: the embedded local system prompt states the same number.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `adj ask` Q1 with `--ref` this slice; wait for the owner's answer.
2. Red tests, then the cap and the texts.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.

Owner decisions (2026-11-16): What line cap replaces the 500-line local Read limit? -> split: the implementer is capped at 150 lines with the Grep-and-window denial, and read-only roles stay at 500 with today's denial [roles.local-read-cap].
